effects.focusSash: At full HP, survives a lethal hit with 1 HP.

effects.shinyStone: Evolves Togetic, Roselia, and related species.

onboarding.title: Quick guide
onboarding.step1Body: From home, head out to battle the marked stretch. Each win advances the story.
onboarding.step2Body: When zone objectives are ready, claim them in Adventure (home) or on the Journey. Don't leave them sitting.
onboarding.step3Body: When the zone is ready, earn the badge to unlock the next stretch.
onboarding.step4Body: Every battle spends energy and it refills on its own: 1 point every 30 minutes.

campaign: Pick an unlocked zone and mark that you're there.
Head out to explore wild battles in that zone.
Complete objectives and challenge trainers or the gym.
battle: Exploring costs energy and finds a wild Pokémon.
You can change zones from the Journey map.
Out of energy: wait, claim rewards, or visit the shop.
market: The Shop sells from the system for coins.
The Market is player-to-player (listings and fees).
Use the tabs to jump between both.
team: Heal the squad at the Pokémon Center (free with a cooldown, or pay to skip it).
Spend each member's points to raise their battle stats.
Manage the PC and Daycare from the other tab.

healTutorial.title: Your Pokémon have fainted
healTutorial.body: Tap the Pokémon Center on Home to heal your team. It's free at the start.

marketTutorial.title: Two ways to trade
marketTutorial.body: The shop sells items for coins; the market is where you trade with other trainers. Listing charges a fee — your badges cut it — and every sale pays commission.

handbook.title: Trainer handbook
handbook.subtitle: How the game actually works: journey, battle, duels and economy — no fluff.

journey.title: The Kanto journey
journey.lead: The story isn't a separate menu — it's the map. Pick a zone, explore there, and challenge the gym when you're ready. Everything else — team, shop, PvP — orbits that loop.

sections.heading: Choose where you are
sections.body: On Journey you set your active zone. That choice drives which wilds appear when you explore and which objectives are waiting. Change zone, change the grind.
bullets: Routes unlock as you clear objectives and badges.
The map shows where you stand and what's next.
You don't need to fight everywhere — chase the next milestone.

sections.heading: Exploring spends energy
sections.body: Hunting wilds costs energy. It regenerates on its own (1 point every 30 minutes). An empty bar takes hours to refill — spend fights wisely.
bullets: No energy means no exploring and no PvP queue.
In a gym, trainers cost 1 and the leader costs 2.
If you're empty: wait, claim dailies, or visit the shop.

sections.heading: Gyms = progress
sections.body: Badges aren't just trophies — they open the path. Losing sets a cooldown; you can skip it with gems if you don't want to wait.
bullets: Train the squad before challenging the leader.
Rematches and leader TMs feed the long game.
Journey tells you when the gym is the next step.

battle.title: Battle
battle.lead: Wilds, trainers and gyms share the same arena. Here’s what matters so you don’t lose to a bad click.

sections.heading: Turns and actions
sections.body: Each turn you Fight, switch, use the bag, or flee (wilds only). The foe acts after you, unless yours fainted.
bullets: Moves have PP — empty means you can’t use them.
Switching costs the turn: the incoming Pokémon may take a hit.
Potions heal in battle; Poké Balls only work on wilds.

sections.heading: Capture
sections.body: Chip the wild’s HP and throw a ball. Weaker foes (and better balls) raise the odds. If it breaks free, the fight continues.
bullets: Master Ball never fails; Ultra and Great improve odds.
A full party sends the catch to the PC.
Shiny and alpha are rare — prioritize catching them.

sections.heading: Status and types
sections.body: Burn, paralysis, poison and sleep swing fights. Types decide effectiveness: a super-effective hit hurts a lot more.
bullets: Held items change the pace (Focus Sash, Choice…).
On a win, XP is split evenly among Pokémon that fought and are still conscious (FireRed style).
If someone can evolve, we offer it on the result screen.

pvp.title: Competitive battles
pvp.lead: PvP is optional. It never blocks the story. Ranked (and challenges) move Elo and your badge; Quick only pays coins.

sections.heading: How Elo moves
sections.body: You start at 1000. Only Ranked and challenges use classic Elo (K = 32): beating someone stronger pays more; losing to someone weaker hurts more. Quick never changes rating.
bullets: Ranked: turn-by-turn — Elo, league, division, and badge.
Quick: instant sim; coins only (×0.6).
Direct challenge: by username, with a cooldown; moves Elo like Ranked.

sections.heading: Rank badges
sections.body: Your badge shows your Elo league. Each league has 3 divisions (III → II → I). After I, you promote to III of the next league.
sections.caption: Eight leagues × three divisions — from Beginner to Legendary

sections.heading: Leagues and rewards
sections.caption: Your league multiplies win coins. Losses ignore this multiplier.

sections.heading: Coins per duel
sections.body: Win base 40 coins × league × mode. Loss base 12 × mode. Always at least 1 coin.
bullets: Queueing or accepting a fight costs 1 energy.
You can set a PvP team; otherwise your adventure team is used.
After the match you see the rating delta (before → after).

sections.heading: Monthly seasons
sections.body: Each UTC month ends a season. On your first fight of the new month, a soft reset applies: 70% of your rating + 30% of 1000. The previous season is archived and you get a prize by league reached.
bullets: Beginner 200 + 5 energy · Rising 400 + 8 · Advanced 650 + 10 + 1 gem · Elite 900 + 12 + 2 gems
Bronze Master 1300 + 15 + 3 · Crystal Master 1800 + 18 + 5 · Champion 2500 + 22 + 8 · Legendary 4000 + 30 + 12 gems
The ranking ladder sorts by current Elo.

economy.title: Coins, gems, and the market
economy.lead: Two currencies, two counters. Coins run the day-to-day; gems are the premium shortcut. The shop sells from the system; the market is player-to-player — with fees that curb abuse.

sections.heading: Coins
sections.body: Earned from exploring, objectives, dailies, PvP, and sales. Spent in the official shop, market listings, healing, renames (after the first free nickname), and more.
bullets: Shop = fixed system prices.
Market = other trainers' listings.
Check your balance on the header resource bar.

sections.heading: Gems
sections.body: Premium currency. Today they come from dailies, weeklies, and PvP season prizes. Use them to skip a gym cooldown (and soon to expand the PC).
bullets: Short cooldown (≤6 h) costs 1 gem; up to 12 h, 2; longer, 3.
You never have to spend them — cooldowns also tick down alone.

sections.heading: Market rules
sections.caption: Listing isn't free: a fee on post, a commission on sale.

sections.heading: Energy as the pace brake
sections.body: Energy isn't currency, but it's the rhythm control: it caps how hard you grind and how many PvP duels fit in a session. Spend it on purpose.
bullets: 1 point every 30 minutes.
Daily and weekly rewards also help you keep pace.

daycare.title: Day Care
daycare.s1: Leave a Pokémon in one of the two nests.
daycare.s2: It levels up on its own while you play something else.
daycare.s3: Collect the levels whenever you want, paying the fee.

fishing.title: Fishing
fishing.s1: The first 5 casts of the day are free; after that each costs 1 energy. If you run out of energy, the free quota returns at midnight.
fishing.s2: A bite gives fragments (rares give more; a shiny comes in whole).
fishing.s3: At 10 fragments you assemble the Pokémon and it goes to your PC.

wonder.title: Wonder Trade
wonder.s1: The first 3 trades of the day are free; after that each costs 1 energy.
wonder.s2: If someone is queued, the trade happens instantly.
wonder.s3: If nobody is, it waits — or trade with the scientist.

corner.title: Game Corner
corner.s1: The first 3 spins each day are free; after that they cost energy.
corner.s2: Spin: the three reels stop on their own, one by one.
corner.s3: If the combination pays, the coins are credited automatically.

farm.title: Orchard
farm.s1: Tap an empty plot and pick a berry to plant.
farm.s2: It takes 2 hours; the plot shows the time left.
farm.s3: Once ready, harvest it for 2 or 3 berries.

mine.title: Mine
mine.s1: You get 8 free digs per day; they don't cost energy. When they're gone, wait for the reset.
mine.s2: Tap a rock: whatever is underneath is yours instantly, nothing to claim.
mine.s3: You can find coins, a Potion, a Water Stone, or fossils. At 10 fragments of the same fossil you revive Omanyte, Kabuto or Aerodactyl.

frontier.title: Frontier
frontier.s2: You win with your current team, without turn-by-turn battles.
frontier.s3: The streak grows with every win and multiplies the reward.
